report_name: 'Coinbasecartel' Ransomware Hits US Fertility Clinic and EU Standards Body

threat_actors.name: coinbasecartel
threat_actors.description: A newly emerged ransomware group employing a double extortion strategy, targeting organizations with highly sensitive data such as a US fertility clinic and European standards bodies. The group threatens to leak stolen data to pressure victims into paying a ransom.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through ransomware and data leakage threats.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: The coinbasecartel group exfiltrated sensitive data from victims before encrypting their systems as part of their double extortion strategy.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The coinbasecartel group deployed their ransomware payload to encrypt victim systems after data exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The attackers likely used vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies to prevent system recovery, a common ransomware tactic.

malware.name: coinbasecartel ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware payload used by the coinbasecartel group to encrypt victim systems and exfiltrate data as part of a double extortion attack.

tools.name: vssadmin
tools.description: Used to delete volume shadow copies to inhibit system recovery.

identities.name: MIM Fertility
identities.description: A prominent U.S. fertility clinic targeted by the coinbasecartel ransomware group, which threatened to leak sensitive patient health information.

identities.name: European Committee for Standardization (CEN)
identities.description: One of the three officially recognized European Standardization Organizations targeted by the coinbasecartel ransomware group.

identities.name: European Committee for Electrotechnical Standardization (Cenelec)
identities.description: One of the three officially recognized European Standardization Organizations targeted by the coinbasecartel ransomware group.

indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 9c5d1e2f-3a4b-4c5d-8e9f-0a1b2c3d4e5f
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.dexpose.io/intel-feeds/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-03
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.

indicators.name: Potential Ransom Note File Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Ransom Note File Creation
id: a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with names commonly associated with ransomware notes.
references:
  - https://www.dexpose.io/intel-feeds/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-03
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: medium
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - 'README.txt'
      - 'DECRYPT'
      - 'RECOVER_'
      - 'INSTRUCTIONS'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of files that are likely ransom notes, based on filename patterns commonly used by ransomware.
